Stefan Thomas (business networking)
Stefan Thomas (business networking) is a business networking entrepreneur from Wiltshire, England. He is a keynote speaker based in the South West of England, UK.
Stefan Thomas is a business networking author. He is known for his notable works: Business Networking for Dummies as part of the For Dummies series and Instant Networking: The Simple Way to Build Your Business Network and See Results in Just 6 Months. Both published by Wiley.
Business Networking
Stefan Thomas has made appearances as a business networking expert, speaking on being an introvert and networking and global networking.
Notable appearances include Acast's In Good Company podcast, Livelink Creators Unlocked, and Namecheap Expert Summit.
